name: nc-return-assembly
description: Final capstone orchestrator that assembles the complete federal + North Carolina filing package for a full-year North Carolina-resident sole proprietor or single-member LLC disregarded for federal tax. Consumes outputs from every upstream federal and North Carolina content skill (bookkeeping, Schedule C/SE, QBI, retirement, SE health insurance, quarterly estimated tax, federal assembly, 1099-NEC, nc-income-tax, nc-estimated-tax, nc-bailey-settlement-retirement where applicable, and nc-sales-tax for closing out the indirect-tax year) to produce a single unified reviewer package: every worksheet, every form, every cross-skill reconciliation, the final taxpayer action list with payment and filing instructions, the next-year NC-40 voucher schedule, and the reviewer brief. This skill does NOT recompute tax — it ORCHESTRATES.
